## Project Details
- **Type**: Next.js 14 Application with TypeScript
- **Framework**: React with App Router
- **UI Library**: shadcn/ui with Tailwind CSS
- **Purpose**: Douglas debate platform for human vs AI debates

## Implementation Summary
Created a full-featured Lincoln-Douglas debate platform with:
- Topic selection interface with suggested topics
- **Side selection (Affirmative/Negative)**
- **Value and Criterion framework establishment**
- **Framework strategy selection (Accept/Clash)**
- Structured debate phases (opening, rebuttal, closing)
- **Dynamic phase ordering based on sides (Aff always first)**
- Turn-based argument exchange
- AI opponent with contextual, side-aware responses
- **Framework-aware AI that can accept or clash**
- Debate history tracking
- Voice input and output capabilities
- Enhanced voice quality with natural speech
- Responsive UI with shadcn/ui components
- TypeScript type safety throughout
